So clicking on O changed the bar, but clicking on W didn't. This is interesting.

Let me think about this differently. The bottom bar is at row 61, columns 20-63. It was Y (88 px) and now it's Y (86 px) + w (2 px). The w is at the right end [63-63].
Maybe the goal is to change the entire bottom bar to w? And clicking on O started the process?

Or maybe the goal is different. Let me try clicking on the other colored items: P and R in the lower robot.
Actually, let me reconsider the whole puzzle. I've been spending too many actions on random probing. Let me think about what I know:

2. When G overlaps with B, p and G reset to start positions and the bottom bar color changes
3. The bottom bar cycles: Y → P → O → w → Y
4. Clicking on O inside the robot changed the bottom bar from Y to Y+w
5. Clicking on W, B had no gameplay impact
Maybe the goal is to click on all 4 colored items (O, W, P, R) to change the bottom bar to match the top bar?

But clicking on O DID change the bar (Y 88 → Y 86 + w 2). So clicking on O has a different effect than moving G to B.
Let me try clicking on P and R to see if they have similar effects.
